source_chapters.title: 第十四章 战魂高昂

summary: Manual extraction for rakudai-kishi-main vol-11. The volume covers the delayed final day of the 62nd Seven Stars Sword-Art Festival after Ikki survives cardiac arrest from the post-semifinal incident. Huge crowds gather at Osaka Bay Dome while Hagun's student council debates whether Stella's dragon power or Ikki's technique will prevail. Stella sleeps and stores energy for the final under Kurono and Nene's watch; Ikki admits his fear of Stella, then undergoes a pre-final gauntlet with Alice, Toka, Moroboshi, Byakuya, Momiji, Kaga, the Hagure sisters and Ouma so he can convert fear into peak readiness. Edelweiss arrives through Tsukikage to watch the final, warning that world powers are also observing Ikki and Stella as future threats or hopes. In the championship, Ikki initially suppresses Stella with prediction, Madoka and close-range pressure, but Stella reveals that Dragon Spirit does not require the self-stabbing motion she showed against Ouma. She turns the ring into a lava field, pushes Ikki to fear, and knocks him unconscious, only for his trained body to counter with Madoka. Ikki then spends Ittou Shura in a one-minute soul clash, reaches the apparent limit of his fate and is blasted out by Katharterio Salamandra. During the count he experiences fate as black chains, breaks them through his love and refusal to let anyone else become Stella's strongest, returns with increased magic, and defeats Stella using Ittou Rasetsu and the final secret sword Oikage. Ikki becomes Seven Stars Sword King, Stella becomes runner-up, and Edelweiss identifies Ikki's awakening as a step into fate-transcending territory that may oppose Tsukikage's despair-filled future. The aftermath includes Ikki and Stella's first night in the infirmary, Shizuku's angry discovery, the setup for Ikki's visit to Stella's father in Familion, Ikki raising Hagun's flag at the award ceremony, and Kagami's final photograph of Ikki and Stella standing side by side.
